title: My Hermes agent builds AI employees for me
content:
My Hermes agent builds AI employees for me.

Just closed another $5K‑a‑month customer today for an AI employee for a design agency.

I'm not even building any of it.

I have Dewey, my Hermes agent, building out the entire Hermes agent for this design agency and onboarding the agent into Slack for me.

All I do is ask the questions, make sure it gets recorded in Granola (my ai notetaker), and then Dewey takes it over from there.

Crazy world we live in.

comments.author: budrscotch
comments.text: For some reason I have a very hard time believing you convinced any business to pay you $5k / mo for a hermes agent deployment
